1.title: Teleprompter Operator Who Bet on Trump Speeches Is Ordered to Pay Fine
1.summary: Gabriel Perez had access to the president’s speeches before they were delivered and was accused of placing unlawful wagers on words that would be spoken.

2.title: High Debt and Rising Prices Catch Up to Trump, as Midterms Near
2.summary: To win in 2024, the president promised an economic course correction. Almost two years later, his agenda has made that fight even harder.

3.title: How Trump’s Deportation Agenda Spreads Overseas
3.summary: Our White House correspondent Zolan Kanno-Youngs explains how so-called third-country deportations are sending immigrants to countries across the globe.

4.title: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
4.summary: An investigation has begun into the storage of weapons for Ukraine's military near a residential area.

5.title: 37 Killed After Russian Strike on Weapons Depot as Ukraine Blames Negligence
5.summary: The depot, which was in a civilian area near Kyiv, “definitely shouldn’t have been there,” President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

6.title: Trump hails 'historic' deal for US to control 65bn barrels of Venezuela's oil
6.summary: Venezuelan interim president says the unusual agreement will help revive her country's economy.
